parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel, providing structural support and rigidity to the appliance.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door, compressor, and insulation panels, maintaining the refrigerator’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed component and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the refrigerator is made of ABS plastic with insulation inside, designed to seal the cooling compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the refrigerator’s interior and maintains the internal temperature by sealing tightly when closed.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Body Interior
parts.Basic_description: The body interior of the refrigerator is made of high-impact polystyrene, forming the inner compartment where food is stored.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a hygienic, easy-to-clean surface and supports shelves and drawers for food organization.
parts.Movement_description: The interior body is stationary, but it supports movable shelves and drawers.
